mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys04_role (sys04_role_id, sys04_role_nm, sys04_note, sys04_seq, sys04_company_id, sys04_default_role, sys04_admin_yn) SELECT f_create_seq() , a.sys04_role_nm , a.sys04_note , a.sys04_seq , #{companyId} , a.sys04_default_role , a.sys04_admin_yn FROM sys04_role a WHERE 1=1 AND a.sys04_role_nm = #{roleNm} AND a.sys04_company_id = #{sourceCompanyId}
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE sys_tree_up( sys06_menu_id , sys06_parent_id , depth , path , cycle ) AS ( SELECT a.sys06_menu_id , a.sys06_parent_id , 0 , ARRAY[a.sys06_menu_nm::text] , false FROM sys06_menu a WHERE 1=1 AND sys06_menu_id = #{menuId} UNION ALL SELECT a.sys06_menu_id , a.sys06_parent_id , b.depth + 1 , array_append(b.path, a.sys06_menu_nm::text) , a.sys06_menu_nm = any(b.path) FROM sys06_menu a INNER JOIN sys_tree_up b ON a.sys06_menu_id = b.sys06_parent_id WHERE 1=1 AND NOT CYCLE ) SELECT a.sys06_menu_id FROM sys_tree_up a
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys03_company_menu (sys03_company_menu_id, sys03_company_id, sys03_menu_id, sys03_use_yn, sys03_note) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , a.sys03_menu_id , a.sys03_use_yn , a.sys03_note FROM sys03_company_menu a WHERE 1=1 AND a.sys03_menu_id = #{menuId} AND a.sys03_company_id = #{sourceCompanyId}
